name: curious-affan-quest-for-knowledge
description: The Curious Affan: Quest for Knowledge - a 3D educational adventure game for preschool children

scripts.test:e2e: node tests/e2e/play.cjs && node tests/e2e/play-desert.cjs && node tests/e2e/realtime.cjs
scripts.build:text-model: VITE_MODEL_AS_TEXT=1 vite build --outDir dist-text && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const d='dist-text/assets/models/';fs.writeFileSync(d+'affan.glb.txt',fs.readFileSync(d+'affan.glb').toString('base64'));fs.rmSync(d+'affan.glb')"
